breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained conflicting instructions, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' method for time integration. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent failed to resolve this conflict and instead incorrectly merged the two, stating to 'Integrate in time with explicit forward Euler combined with Strang splitting'. This is incorrect, as the Strang splitting method described does not use forward Euler for its sub-steps; it uses exact solutions. The agent repeated the user's error by including the incorrect method.
